c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.1.evidence: with Akismet active and a (fake) key so Akismet::is_available is true: admin posting the spam test string -> 201 publish in 0.05s, versus 0.8s for the member (no outbound check for staff); a live Akismet verdict needs a real key

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.2.evidence: test_editor (space admin of Help Desk) reply -> 201 publish instantly with the key set

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.3.evidence: test_moderator POST reply in Bug Reports -> 201 publish

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.4.evidence: test_moderator topic in General Discussion -> 201 publish in 0.04s

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.5.evidence: needs a real Akismet API key (third-party service): with a fake key the API is unreachable so the spam test string cannot be classified; qa_rft_b posting it published (fail-open)

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.6.evidence: member normal topic published; took 0.78s (an outbound Akismet call was attempted) against 0.05s for staff

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.9.evidence: Akismet key set but API unreachable from the container: member topic still publishes 201 (fail-open), no fatal
